caution: HTTP 200 may contain an emergency service page or another invalid HTML response instead of the disaster SMS board. Never treat a missing board as a valid zero-alert result. Preserve cached values on data-validation errors and expose their stale status; clear values only after a valid zero-alert response.

The component-level changelog.jsonl and caution.jsonl contain pre-existing mixed encodings. Keep new repository-level records in UTF-8 without BOM; do not rewrite the legacy files as part of the safety-alert fix.

Timestamp sensors must return timezone-aware datetime objects, not date strings. Use ZoneInfo for Asia/Seoul; directly replacing tzinfo with a pytz timezone may produce an incorrect historical offset. Include native-value type and offset checks in regression coverage.

State triggers without from/to filters react to attribute-only changes. Do not expose polling timestamps or changing freshness diagnostics on alert sensors used for TTS; retain this metadata internally or expose it on separate diagnostic entities.

naver_weather pins beautifulsoup4==4.9.3; requiring >=4.13.0 in another integration is unsatisfiable in the shared HA environment. Validate parser compatibility before raising the minimum. A successful docker exec Python check does not establish the module state inside the running HA process.
